What does #MeToo say or mean to you? 🤔

I am researching different movements and issues that are relevant for a woman of my age in today's society. Working on putting it together in a book. #MondayMotivation https://t.co/Xb8AF11Ksi

#MeToo was popularized by American actress Alyssa Milano, on Twitter in 2017. Milano encouraged victims of sexual harassment to tweet about it and "give people a sense of the magnitude of the problem". https://t.co/eUKSYx25ty

After #MeToo started, new hashtags came out e.g. #ChurchToo, #MeTooMilitary  and even one for astronomers #astroSH. Also just as important #HimToo.  It has impacted on so many industries and parts of society.  I love the fact that it enables people to speak out. 👍 https://t.co/RAiTKgxrTG
